articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Text, Image, Audio, and Video
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that processes text, images, audio, and video within a single unified architecture rather than through adapter modules. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on complex multi-step reasoning tasks over its predecessor, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model also introduces a 1M-token context window as the default tier for API users.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 scored a gold-medal equivalent on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, marking the first time an AI system has consistently matched top human competitors in formal mathematical reasoning. The system uses a novel chain-of-verification approach that self-audits proof steps, reducing logical errors by over 60%. This has significant implications for automated theorem proving and formal verification in software engineering.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Limited Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has begun a pilot deployment across three Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas and Tennessee, handling bin-picking, packing, and palletizing tasks. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for zero-shot object manipulation, reportedly achieving 94% grasp success rates on previously unseen items. The partnership signals an acceleration of humanoid robotics in logistics, with both companies projecting scaled deployment by mid-2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Construction Site Inspections
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics has deployed its electric Atlas humanoid robot for fully autonomous structural inspections on active construction sites in partnership with Skanska. The robot navigates unstructured terrain, climbs ladders, and uses LiDAR plus onboard vision models to generate real-time 3D defect maps compared against BIM models. Early results show a 5x speedup in inspection cycles and detection of structural deviations as small as 2mm.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 with 400B Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4, a 400-billion-parameter open-weight model available under a revised permissive license allowing commercial use without revenue thresholds. The model introduces a mixture-of-experts architecture with 16 active experts per forward pass, delivering performance competitive with GPT-5 on coding and reasoning benchmarks while running efficiently on 4-node GPU clusters. The release includes fine-tuning tooling optimized for enterprise retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node at its Kaohsiung fab, roughly two months ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction compared to N2, enabled by next-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. Apple and NVIDIA are confirmed as launch customers, with chips expected in consumer products by Q3 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trials Targeting Spinal Cord Injuries
articles.summary: The FDA has granted Neuralink approval to expand its N2 brain-computer interface clinical trials to include patients with spinal cord injuries, beyond the initial cohort of ALS and paralysis patients. The expanded trial will evaluate bidirectional neural signaling — not only reading motor intent but also delivering sensory feedback to cortical regions. Early pilot data showed participants regaining partial fine motor control of robotic limbs with latency under 10 milliseconds.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Bezos Expeditions, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in South Carolina targeting annual production of 10,000 units by 2028. Figure's latest Figure 03 platform integrates a custom vision-language-action model co-developed with OpenAI that enables the robot to follow complex natural language task instructions in warehouse and retail environments.
